journal_lines: Blaze near the magma. Heat radiating.
Fire and spinning rods. Kept moving.
It found me first. That's fine.
Charged through the smoke. Worth it.
A small sun on a long axle. Bright. Briefer than it looked.
Spat fire the way a kettle spits steam. Same temperature, more intent.
Smelled like a furnace that had a name once and forgot it.
Spinning rods, each one a small grievance, all going the same direction.
Closed the distance during the breath between volleys. They breathe.
Heat shimmered off the walls for a long time after.
Rods cool in the bag quicker than I would have guessed.
Light went out of the room when it fell. Slowly. Like a memory.
